summary: Forum file drop 12 (CSV, 43 channels) shows 9 names with a NUL followed by old bytes, e.g. 'Channel 1\x00t Mode' and 'RPT 15\x00 23'. Stock CHIRP's get_memory only strips trailing NUL/FF/space, so the leftover text shows in NewChirp and in CSV exports; zone get_name and the settings channel-name choices had the same trailing-only strip. The reporter described it as 'adds test to first channel on read'.
title: Channel names show leftover text after the NUL terminator ('Channel 1<NUL>t Mode')
